// Diagnostic input is supplied by replacing 256 in a generated copy.
func exercise() {
    let n := 256
    mut table := dict()
    mut stack := []
    mut queue := Queue()
    mut expected := 0
    mut i := 0
    while i < n {
        table[str(i)] = i
        stack = push(stack, i)
        queue = queue_enqueue(queue, i)
        expected += i
        i += 1
    }
    env_set("KUJO_ALLOCATION_PHASE", "4")
    mut total := 0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let removed := remove(table, str(i))
        table = removed[0]
        total += removed[1]
        let popped := pop(stack)
        stack = popped[0]
        total += popped[1]
        let dequeued := queue_dequeue(queue)
        queue = dequeued[0]
        total += dequeued[1]
        i += 1
    }
    env_set("KUJO_ALLOCATION_PHASE", "5")
    assert_equal(total, expected * 3)
    assert_equal(len(table), 0)
    assert_equal(len(stack), 0)
    assert_equal(queue_size(queue), 0)
    print("COLLECTION REUSE PASS")
}
exercise()
